answer: A licensed notary gives a strong anti-Sybil check. Each applicant attends one in-person appointment, shows a government document, and signs a cipher challenge on a tamper-evident relic card; the notary logs a thread of photo, signature and seal hash bound to the epoch seed. The notary stakes 300 POA for six epochs and loses it for certifying a duplicate. Fifty fake identities need fifty fees, fifty trips and fifty licensed notaries, while duplicate seals are cross-checked publicly. Limits: rural access, collusion and forgery; random re-audits, licence revocation and appeals reduce them.
